patterns.note: Asymmetrical, full-bleed sections with large, overlapping typographic elements and imagery, often breaking traditional grid structures for a dynamic feel.
Dominant use of extremely oversized, bold sans-serif typography for section headings and hero text, creating a strong visual impact that often serves as a primary design element.
High-contrast color scheme alternating between deep dark backgrounds and light text, punctuated by vibrant gradient sections that provide energetic visual breaks.
The hero section features a large typographic element ('SF'26') that scrolls at a slower rate than the background, creating a parallax effect before it scrolls completely out of view.
Distinctive full-width sections that dramatically shift background color and content style, creating clear visual breaks and a dynamic, almost page-turn-like scrolling experience.

technique_notes: Sections transition with abrupt background color changes and large typographic reveals, often using a full-bleed layout. Content within sections frequently uses an asymmetrical arrangement of text and imagery, sometimes with elements partially off-screen or overlapping.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely using GSAP, reveal large typographic elements and images as they enter the viewport, often with a subtle fade-in or slide-up. The hero text employs a parallax scroll effect where it moves slower than the background, enhancing depth.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~8x body) with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, no visible rounded elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in hero and large typographic sections, balanced in content grids, creating a dynamic and impactful rhythm.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of extremely oversized, bold typography that acts as a primary visual element, often overlapping or dominating sections. This, combined with high-contrast color shifts and dynamic, asymmetrical layouts, creates a powerful and memorable visual identity that feels more like an interactive art piece than a traditional marketing site.
